mapper.insert: insert into booknest.`tag`(id, name, use_count, status) values (#{id}, #{name}, #{useCount}, #{status})
mapper.select: select t.id, t.name, t.status, t.create_time, t.update_time, (select count(*) from booknest.`post_tag` pt where pt.tag_id = t.id) as use_count from booknest.`tag` t where t.id = #{id}
select t.id, t.name, t.status, t.create_time, t.update_time, (select count(*) from booknest.`post_tag` pt where pt.tag_id = t.id) as use_count from booknest.`tag` t where t.name = #{name}

select t.id, t.name, t.status, t.create_time, t.update_time, (select count(*) from booknest.`post_tag` pt where pt.tag_id = t.id) as use_count from booknest.`tag` t order by use_count desc, t.name asc

select t.id, t.name, t.status, t.create_time, t.update_time, (select count(*) from booknest.`post_tag` pt where pt.tag_id = t.id) as use_count from booknest.`tag` t order by use_count desc, t.name asc limit #{limit}
